text:
alex: Heads-up — planning a short overnight soft-evac across us-east1 GPU pool to roll kernel + NIC microcode. Target window 02:00-04:00 UTC. Expect ~7% transient capacity loss per cohort.

maria: ETA on canary cohort? any expected spike for hosted API tail latency?

alex: Canary = 1 rack (cohort A) at 02:00. We'll monitor p95+ for generation routes. Smart routing should steer traffic but long-seq jobs may see latency bump; recommend moving heavy batches earlier.

jamal: What's the drain command sequence? need to seed KV cache after reboot?

alex: We'll use the standard drain + cordon script:
```
kubectl cordon gpu-node-XXX
kubectl drain gpu-node-XXX --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=120
```
After node returns we'll run kv-seed job: `jobs/kv-seed --pool=us-east1-gpu --parallel=10`.

sophie: Cost note — pre-warming burst spare for warm fallback will add ~0.8% hourly spend during window. Are we ok with that?

ben: small cost vs outage risk. Suggest staggering cohorts every 20 mins across AZs to limit simultaneous capacity loss. Also add short canary rollback policy: 10m watch then continue.

alex: Agreed. Plan: cohorts of 3 racks, 20m stagger, canary at 02:00 in az1, if p95 increases >200ms or error rate >0.5% rollback. Fallback model routing to cpu-quantized variant for latency-sensitive tenants.

maria: I'll update Hosted API status page and add note about potential minor latency for long-sequence gen.

jamal: I'll queue the kv-seed jobs and a post-maint validation that checks prefix hit rates and throughput.

ben: Ops runbook updated with rollback steps and tenant comm snippets.

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: maintenance window (us-east1 GPU) 2026-05-02 02:00-04:00 UTC — notifier to #customer-success in 1h. :bell:

alex: Quick checklist before window:
- add tenant holdbacks for big-batch training jobs
- set autoscaling buffers +15% for 3 hrs
- enable detailed tracing on generation routes
- notify dedicated customers in next 30m

sophie: tagging finance — we'll track incremental cost under tag `maint/us-east1-20260502`.

maria: all good from my side. I'll ping when customer comms are live.

alex: thanks team. running preflight now (10m). will post final go/no-go in this thread.
